1 INTRODUCTION

The City of Kalamazoo is submitting this Fiscal Year 2027 Drinking Water Revolving Fund Project
Plan for Non-Copper Water Service Replacements. This FY2027 Project Plan is a resubmittal of
previously submitted and approved FY26 DWRF Project Plan for Non-copper water service
replacements (EGLE Project Number 7903-01). A copy of that agreement is in Appendix A.

The FY2026 Project Plan is the re-submittal of the previously submitted and approved FY25 DWRF
Project Plan for Non-copper water service replacements (EGLE Project Number 7866-01). A copy of
that agreement is in Appendix B.

The FY25 DWRF Project Plan was a re-submittal of the previously approved FY2024 project plan
which included Lead Service Replacements for Fiscal Years 2024-2028 (EGLE Project Number
7810-01). A copy of that agreement is in Appendix C.

2 BACKGROUND
The FY27 service area can be seen in Figure 1. Based on 2020 Census data, the current population of
the FY27 project area is 41,868. Based on the current population projections for the City, the 2047
projected population for the project area is 40,386. The area is currently nearly fully developed and
land use is not expected to change. Kalamazoo has had no health-based violations in the past 5 years.
Project areas are planned ahead of road projects and coordinated with other utilities for a dig-once
approach, when possible. Kalamazoo has a current asset management plan.

4 COST SUMMARY
The City of Kalamazoo has performed additional investigations for non-copper services in the FY27
project area, bringing the total number of services to be replaced to 1,900. A revised cost estimate for
FY27 service replacements can be found in Appendix D.

Based on a project cost of $19,000,000, a project loan funded at 3% for 20 years would require an
annual payment of $1,239,900. Given the calculated number of 55,900 Residential Equivalent Units
in the system, the anticipated annual cost of $22.18/REU is anticipated for the FY27 Non-copper
service replacement project.
